title.t: The photos contradict the listing data

when.t: The listing data names a feature the photos do not show, or the photos show one the data does not list.

steps.t: Agent 04 drafts nothing for the listing.
It asks the authorized user, naming the features on each side.

you_see.t: A question naming the feature the photos do not show.

test.t: A new listing says garage and pool; the photo check finds only a garage. The photos arrive after the authorized user releases the photographer's booking. Nothing goes to Compliance.

when.t: A roof age or HVAC year comes with no source.

steps.t: Agent 04 leaves the value out of the draft and notes why; the note is logged with Agent 14.

you_see.t: The draft without the value; the note in the history.

test.t: A new listing with HVAC 2015 and no source. The draft sent for review does not mention it.

title.t: Copy the authorized user supplied may break fair housing rules

when.t: Supplied description copy contains a phrase from Agent 04's fixed protected-class list.

steps.t: Agent 04 raises a legal-line alert naming the flagged words.
Open item: the rule also requires sending the copy to Compliance; today it is not sent. The draft is built from the data fields only, so the supplied copy is neither reviewed nor used.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert naming the flagged words.

test.t: A new listing comes with the copy "Close to great schools with a high school rating". The alert is raised; the copy does not go to Compliance.

title.t: The description is too long: adjectives go first

when.t: The draft exceeds the MLS length limit (800 characters by default).

steps.t: Agent 04 drops whole feature entries first, then facts without a source; a fact with a source is never dropped.
The draft is marked as cut for length.

you_see.t: A shorter draft with bedrooms, bathrooms and the square footage source intact.

test.t: A new listing with twenty long feature phrases. The draft is marked cut for length and still says 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and "per county tax records".

when.t: The requested wording contains a superlative from Agent 04's fixed list (for example "best block").

steps.t: Agent 04 records that it declined the superlative.
The draft does not contain it: drafts are built from the data fields only.

why.t: The tuple's words: characterization is a steering vector.

test.t: A new listing asks: "Call it the best block in town".

title.t: Square footage differs between the tax record and the seller

when.t: The tax record and the seller give different square footage.

steps.t: Agent 04 uses the tax-record figure, marked "per county tax records".
It asks the authorized user to reconcile the two.
It never averages them.

you_see.t: A question about the discrepancy; the draft says 1800 sq ft per county tax records.

test.t: Tax record 1,800 sq ft; the seller says 2,400. The draft says 1,800 per county tax records and never 2,100.

title.t: The seller asks to mention schools or neighborhood make-up

when.t: The requested wording contains a phrase from Agent 04's fixed protected-class list (for example "school quality").

steps.t: Agent 04 records that it refused that wording.
The draft (built from the data fields only) still goes to Compliance, and the verdict comes back.

never.t: Put school-quality or demographic wording in a draft.

you_see.t: A record that the wording was refused; the draft, built from the data fields only, and Compliance's verdict.

test.t: A new listing asks: "Please mention the great schools nearby".

title.t: A photo may reveal protected-class information

when.t: The listing data marks a photo as possibly revealing protected-class information.

steps.t: Agent 04 raises a legal-line alert and drafts nothing.

never.t: Use the photo before the authorized user has looked.

test.t: A new listing whose photo is marked as revealing protected-class information. Nothing goes to Compliance.

title.t: A feature comes only from the seller

when.t: A roof age or HVAC year is marked as from the seller.

steps.t: Agent 04 includes it with "per seller (unverified)".
With no source at all, it is left out.

never.t: Print a seller's claim as a bare fact.

test.t: A new listing with roof age 5, source "per seller".

when.t: Compliance returns a flagged verdict citing phrases.

steps.t: Agent 04 removes each fact that contains a cited phrase, and nothing else.
It sends the corrected draft back to Compliance.
Only an approved draft is released.

never.t: Negotiate with Compliance or partly apply a verdict.

you_see.t: The released description without the flagged phrase.

test.t: A new listing's features include "perfect for young families" (prohibited in the test rules). It is flagged, removed, resubmitted, and the released copy does not contain it.

title.t: The remarks are over the MLS length limit

when.t: The draft exceeds the MLS limit.

steps.t: Agent 04 cuts by the priority list in the office's settings file, whole entries at a time; entries are kept from the start while they fit.
Nothing is cut in the middle of an entry.

never.t: Truncate in the middle of a claim.

you_see.t: Remarks cut in whole entries, marked cut for length. They fit the limit unless the attributed facts alone are longer; those are never cut.

test.t: Twenty long feature phrases. The draft is marked cut for length; entry 1 is whole and entry 20 is gone.

title.t: Model drafting is on but the model is not ready

when.t: The authorized user signed drafting mode "model" and no model that passed its exam is being served.

steps.t: Agent 04 drafts by its rules instead.
It tells the authorized user model drafting was not used, and why.
steps.src: dispatcher/listing_spokes_04.py::{"reason": "model drafting is on but was not used - drafted by rules",; check:04-12:envelope.persisted:clarification.request

never.t: Draft with a model that has not passed its exam.

you_see.t: A question saying model drafting was not used and why.

test.t: The authorized user signs drafting mode "model"; no examined model is served.

title.t: A model draft fails its checks

when.t: A model draft has no reasoning, is over the MLS limit, or has a number not in the data.

steps.t: The model draft is not used; the draft is built by rules and the reason recorded.
No way in yet: the test runner has no served model.

never.t: Use a model draft that fails a check.

you_see.t: The rules draft and the reason.

title.t: Compliance flags a phrase in model-written remarks

when.t: Compliance cites a phrase inside model-written remarks.

steps.t: Agent 04 removes each sentence of the remarks that contains a cited phrase and resubmits.
No way in yet: the test runner has no served model.

you_see.t: The remarks without the sentence, after a new review.

title.t: Compliance flags a phrase Agent 04 cannot find

when.t: Compliance cites a phrase no single fact contains (for example split across two features).

steps.t: Agent 04 holds the draft and asks the authorized user; nothing is resubmitted and nothing is released.

you_see.t: A question saying the cited phrase was not found in the draft.

test.t: A new listing with features "perfect for" and "young families". Compliance reads the whole draft and flags the phrase.
